method: Hold native and proxy Auto curve/LUT artifacts fixed separately. Shared compare_images.diff with reference_size=(1600,1067). Native references verified byte-identical for each fit.

varianceDerivation.assumption: Independent input noise; normalized Mitchell weights with clamped duplicate taps combined. Analytic double precision, not a demosaic covariance calibration.

interpretation: Kernel-derived independent-noise variance scaling improves both fixed-fit means below 2.0 on this fixture. This supports investigating resize-aware noise calibration, not a production parity pass. The prior area-ratio experiment did not account for the implemented Mitchell filter.
limitations: One camera fixture; demosaic covariance remains uncalibrated.
The scalar averages spatially varying filter energy; double-precision analytic weights are not exact Rust f32 execution.
Reference uses Preview reconstruction at native output size, not production full-resolution export.
Auto fit cache is deliberately seeded; ordinary host fitting and CPU/GPU parity remain unqualified.
No production rendering math, default, or acceptance budget changed.
nextRequiredEvidence: Validate noise propagation through reconstruction and resizing, then run ordinary host preview versus full-quality export and CPU/GPU comparisons across the fixture corpus.
